# Academy for Breastfeeding Medicine (ABM)

> Professional membership organization dedicated to advancing breastfeeding medicine education, advocacy, and clinical practice through physician networks, special interest groups, and evidence-based resources.

ABM serves physicians and healthcare professionals in breastfeeding medicine through membership programs, educational initiatives, volunteer opportunities, and leadership development. The organization provides access to clinical resources, hosts regional conferences and webinars, and advocates for breastfeeding families through policy statements and professional partnerships.

- Academy for Breastfeeding Medicine
